notes: «حدثنا أبي» names the father of Wahb as a bare relation: kind relation.
«عن رجل، يقال له السائب» names him in the text: read as narrator; the editor gloss «وهو عندنا أبو السائب» is left out.

«قال دخلنا على أبي سعيد الخدري» is a first-person narrative: Abu Sa'id is the host in the scene, not a transmitter, and the Prophet's words come in the story. Needs a ruling on whether Abu Sa'id is a link.

«قال دخلنا على أبي سعيد الخدري» is a first-person narrative: Abu Sa'id is the host in the scene, not a transmitter, and the Prophet's words come in the story. Needs a ruling on whether Abu Sa'id is a link.
«رجل يقال له السائب» names the man, so «رجل» is not left unnamed; the editor gloss «- وهو عندنا أبو السائب -» is left out
«دخلنا على أبي سعيد الخدري» is the house where the story was heard, not a link (rule 6)
«نحو حديث مالك عن صيفي» names another transmitter for the same saying, so it is a variant group
